race.description: Hartleys Fresh Market Ballina Fair Mdn Hcp
race.comment: QUEEN OF THINKING (8) stepped out in a fairly strong Maiden on debut, with a tiring eighth over 1400m at Newcastle. Will appreciate the extra journey in a very average race. Go close. MISSION WISE (2) covered ground in the run first up with a plugging fifth over 1400m at Dalby. Finds a suitable assignment this time from a good draw. Each way. SO SAIN (9) is on a quick back-up after going out hard before tiring late to run fifth over 1526m at Lismore. Claim helps again and deserves another chance. MONEY ON MY MIND (6) found some form at her last two outings and can slide across from the awkward gate today. Gripped on late in the small field when second over 1400m at Armidale. Respect.
